newsitem.title: USA: Milestone completes private placement for $4 mln.
newsitem.headline: Milestone completes private placement for $4 mln.

text.p: Milestone Scientific Inc said Monday it completed a private placement of unregistered securities.
The company said gross proceeds from the placement totaled $4 million for 852,262 units, each consisting of one share of common stock and one warrant to buy a share of common, exercisable at $4.72.
The placement was over-subscribed, said the company and it accepted subscriptions for somewhat more than the maximum number of units offered.
